title: User mode networking WSL instance is never removed
body:
### Issue Description

To support user-mode networking on WSL, a second WSL distribution is started (beyond the podman machine):

```pwsh
> podman machine init --user-mode-networking --now 
> wsl --list
podman-machine-default
podman-net-usermode
```

The problem is that the `podman-net-usermode` isn't removed after `podman machine rm` or `podman machine reset` and will be there forever until the user run `wsl --unregister podman-net-usermode`.

### Steps to reproduce the issue

Steps to reproduce the issue
1. `podman machine init --provider=wsl --user-mode-networking --now`
2. `podman machine stop && podman machine rm`
3. `wsl -l`


### Describe the results you received

```pwsh
> podman machine ls
NAME        VM TYPE     CREATED     LAST UP     CPUS        MEMORY      DISK SIZE
> wsl --list
podman-net-usermode
```

### Describe the results you expected

The `podman-net-usermode` WSL distribution should be removed when the machine is removed.
